CHECKER_VERDICT: no load-bearing defect; four MATERIAL findings carried in the record
WHAT_IS_PERMITTED_TO_BE_CLAIMED: nothing. The campaign under-accrued against its own frozen minimum: 33 valid paired blocks against 41. That fact alone settles the disposition, and the paired statistics play no part in it. No causal effect is established, and no absence of one is established either.
IS_ANY_FURTHER_EXPERIMENT_AUTHORISED: No. SECOND_CLEAN_RESTART is forbidden, SECOND_TARGETED_MEASUREMENT_CAMPAIGN is forbidden, and nothing here authorises a successor.
OWNER_INTERPRETATION_RULE: fewer than 41 pairs may not be interpreted using the paired p-values, even when they were computed descriptively
A_RETRACTION: the C4 commit message and the first version of the final report argued from the two p-values — that reaching 41 pairs would not have changed the disposition, and that the positive medians were indistinguishable from noise. Both are inferences from an under-accrued sample and both are retracted. See OMLDCT02_UNDER_ACCRUAL_INTERPRETATION_RULE.json. The C4 commit message is immutable and stands wrong.
